1 # Yer 49.7-22 Obadia anisoadehunu nie.
Sei na AWURADE Nyankopɔn ka fa Edom ho:
Yɛate AWURADE anomu asɛm
sɛ wasoma abɔfoɔ ma wɔakɔ amanaman mu sɛ:
Monsɔre, momma yɛnsɔre ntia Edom ne no nkɔko.
2AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Edom sɛ:
Hwɛ, mayɛ wo amanaman mu ketewa, wɔabu wo animtia pa ara.
3 # Num 24.21 W’akoma ahantan adaadaa wo,
wo a wote ɔbotan ntokuro mu,
deɛ ɛhɔ korɔn ne w’adwa,
wose no w’akoma mu sɛ:
Hwan na ɔbɛtumi ayi me asi fam?
4Sɛ wotu kɔ soro sɛ ɔkɔdeɛ,
na sɛ wode wo pirebuo si nsoromma ntam mpo a,
ɛhɔ na mɛduru abɛfa wo afiri,
AWURADE asɛm nie.
5Sɛ awifoɔ, anaa adwotwafoɔ
ba wo so anadwo a,
sɛ wɔrewia wo mpo a,
anka wɔrennya wo ase anaa?
Sɛ obobe abatefoɔ bɛtete w’aba a,
anka wɔremma mpɛpɛ nka anaa?
6Na wo Esau deɛ, hwɛ wɔapra w’adeɛ apɛ w’ahuntadeɛ
na wɔayɛ wo dosodoso.
7Wɔn a wɔne wo wɔ apam nyinaa adaadaa wo
abɛduru ɛhyeɛ so;
wɔn a wo ne wɔn te asomdwoeɛ mu adaadaa wo afa wo so;
wɔn a wɔdii w’aduane asum w’ase fidie;
nanso wonnim.
8Ɛnyɛ ɛda no,
na mɛsɛe anyansafoɔ afiri Edom
ne nhunumu afiri Esau bepɔ soɔ?
AWURADE asɛm nie.
9Teman, wo nnɔmmarima akoma bɛtu,
na wɔakum nnipa nyinaa afiri Esau bepɔ so.
Sɛnti a wɔbɛtwe Edom aso
10 # Yoel 3.19 Atirimuɔden a wode bɔɔ wo nua Yakob nti
na aniwuo bɛkata wo ho,
na wɔatwa wo atwene akɔsi daa.
11Ɛda a wobɛgyinaa ntentensoɔ,
ɛda a ananafoɔ faa ne dɔm nnommum kɔeɛ,
na ahɔhoɔ hyɛnee ne kuro apono mu
na wɔtwee Yerusalem so ntonto no,
ɛno mu na wo nso woyɛɛ sɛ wɔn mu baako.
12 # Dwom 137.7 Nanso ɛnsɛ sɛ anka wode anigyeɛ hwɛ wo nua,
ɛda a abuo buu no no;
ɛnsɛ sɛ anka w’ani gye Yuda mma
wɔn sɛeɛ da no ho,
ɛnsɛ sɛ anka wohyehyɛ wo ho
wɔ ahohiahia da no,
13ɛnsɛ sɛ anka wohyɛne me man kuro pono no mu,
wɔn amanehunu da no;
ɛnsɛ sɛ anka wode anigyeɛ hwɛ wɔn amanehunu,
wɔn amanehunu da no;
ɛnsɛ sɛ anka wotene wo nsa sɔ wɔn ahodeɛ mu,
wɔn amanehunu da no;
14ɛnsɛ sɛ anka wogyina nkwanta soɔ
twitwa ne mfirimufoɔ guo;
ɛnsɛ sɛ anka woyi ne nnipa a wɔaka no ma,
ahohiahia da no.
15 # Yoel 1.15; Yer 50.15, 29 Na AWURADE da no abɛn, amanaman nyinaa so;
Edom sɛdeɛ woyɛeɛ no, saa ara na wɔbɛyɛ woɔ,
wo nneyɛe bɛsane abɛbua w’atifi.
16 # Yer 25.15 Na sɛdeɛ amanehunu boroo me man Yuda sɛ nsa wɔ me bepɔ kronkron no soɔ no,
saa ara na ɛbɛboro amanaman nyinaa daa daa,
na amanehunu no bɛmene wɔn
na w’ase ahye koraa.
AWURADE ahennie no
17 # Yoel 2.32; 3.17 Na Sion bepɔ so deɛ, mfirimufoɔ bɛtena hɔ,
na ayɛ kronkronbea,
na Yakob fie bɛsane afa wɔn agyapadeɛ adi so.
18 # Sak 12.6 Na Yakob fie bɛyɛ ogya,
na Yosef fie ayɛ ogyaframa,
na Esau fie deɛ ɛbɛyɛ nkyɛnkyɛmma,
na wɔadɛre wɔn mu ahye wɔn
a obiara renka mma Esau fie,
ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE na waka.
19Na anafoɔ famfoɔ bɛfa Esau bepɔ adi so,
na asaseta sofoɔ bɛfa Filistifoɔ deɛ adi so,
na wɔbɛfa Efraim asase ne Samaria asase adi so,
na Benyamin afa Gilead adi so.
20Na dɔm yi a ɛyɛ Israelfoɔ deɛ no nnommum a wɔwɔ Kanaanfoɔ mu no
bɛdi asase no so de akɔsi Sarefat,
na Yerusalem nnommum a wɔwɔ Sefarad no
bɛfa Negeb nkuro no adi so.
21Na agyefoɔ bɛforo aba Sion bepɔ so
na wɔabɛdi Esau bepɔ so,
na ahennie no bɛyɛ AWURADE dea.

sɛ wasoma abɔfoɔ ma wɔakɔ amanaman mu sɛ:

Teman, wo nnɔmmarima akoma bɛtu,

Atirimuɔden a wode bɔɔ wo nua Yakob nti

Ɛda a wobɛgyinaa ntentensoɔ,

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
